admin.staffUsersHelp: Internal accounts with staff roles (admin, lister, etc.).
admin.clientsHelp: People who registered on the public site to track offers.
admin.statusHelp: Saving the form does not change status. Use these buttons to update visibility.
admin.listingLockedHelp: This listing is not in draft. Switch to Draft to edit details, photos, beds, and baths.
admin.saveBeforePhotos: Save the listing first, then you can upload photos below.
admin.photosHelp: Upload photos before or while creating the listing. Structured mode counts beds and baths from the rooms you tag.
admin.structuredUploadHint: Choose floor (for houses), room type, and label — then upload all photos for that room.
admin.structuredHouseHint: Example: ground floor → Drawing Room (3 photos), ground floor → Bed 1, basement → Bed 1.
admin.structuredFlatHint: Flats skip floor — upload directly to Bed 1, Bed 2, etc.
admin.structuredBlocksHint: Add a room block with +, pick floor and room type, then upload. Each bedroom or bathroom block counts toward beds and baths automatically.
admin.confirmRemoveRoomSlot: Remove this room and all its photos?
admin.bulkUploadHint: Upload all photos at once, then enter beds and baths manually below.
admin.dropPhotosHint: Drag and drop images here, or click Browse
admin.photoReorderHint: Drag ⋮⋮ to reorder within a room. Use “Set as cover” for the search thumbnail — no need to drag a photo all the way to the front.
admin.confirmClearAllPhotos: Remove all photos from this listing?
admin.selectLocationFirst: Select city and sector before uploading photos.
admin.bulkBedsHint: Bulk upload: enter beds and baths manually.
admin.photoConfigHelp: Configure floor options, room types per floor, and auto room labels (English & Chinese).
admin.roomTypeLabelHelp: Set the default room label per type. Auto-number adds 1, 2, 3… for beds and baths.
admin.floorRoomTypesHelp: Choose which room types appear when a floor is selected during photo upload.
admin.subtypeFloorsHelp: Choose which floors appear when uploading photos for a property subtype (e.g. House). Leave all unchecked to hide floors for that subtype.
admin.photoConfigMissingSeed: No floors found. Restart the API so migrations and seed can restore defaults, or run npm run db:migrate and npm run db:seed in the api package.
